$comment: Corrections to the vendored expr.jsonschema.json (foundation-sdk v0.0.20). Sources are Grafana's server-side expression query types (pkg/expr/query.types.json) at the tag in `grafana`; at v12.4.11 and v13.2.2 they match the vendored schema except for this key. See src/spec/overlay.ts.

value.description: Fingerprints of the series already firing, written by Grafana while it evaluates a rule with a recovery threshold. Supersedes loadedDimensions. Never set it by hand.

patches.why: New in 13.x: Grafana keeps the firing series of a hysteresis threshold here, so a stored rule can carry it.
